Spring Boot best practices: Maven (`pom.xml`) or Gradle (`build.gradle`); use Spring Boot starters. Organize by feature/domain. Always use constructor-based injection; declare dependencies `private final`. Use component stereotypes appropriately. Configure via `application.yml`/`application.properties`; use type-safe properties and Spring Profiles (`application-dev.yml`, `application-prod.yml`). Do not hardcode secrets. Use environment variables or Vault/AWS Secrets Manager.

Design consistent REST APIs; use DTOs, not entities. Do not expose JPA entities directly to the client. Validate DTOs; provide global exception handling. Keep business logic in stateless services; manage transactions declaratively at the most granular level. Use Spring Data `JpaRepository`/`CrudRepository`, custom queries or Criteria API, and DTO projections.

Use SLF4J; parameterized logging. Write JUnit 5/Mockito unit tests, context-loading integration tests, test
